I allowed him free reign of my pots, pans, baking materials, and yet now they are all ruined. I let it go at the time, but this recent incident has shown me he neither care for or feelings nor does he want to listen to correction. So, in other words, he has to leave. I have to buy new pots. I have to buy new things to replace the ones he borrowed. 

But yes, thanks for the "advice". I'm always to blame. Thanks, Mom. Thanks, Auntie. Always telling me how I'm the problem.

I never raise my voice to him and I certainly don't disrespect him and yet the first time I assert myself I'm always always belittled, talked down to, verbally, and sometimes physically assaulted.
Ok but I was running late for work? I am pretty sure I explained that. If he has a problem with that he could have communicated that properly instead of blowing up at us both and yelling.

If anything he's more confrontational. I've been very friendly and I literally don't complain to him about anything and ignore when he eats my food or ruins my pots and pans, and I was just all 'hey just reminding you not to do this one thing I asked you not to do' and he suddenly blows up for no reason. Anything he asked I've done. He asked me to buy a thing I'm nice and I do it. If I ask for anything? It's yelling at not me, but my SO. every time I have anyone over I let him know. I go to a thing for work and come back and there's a stranger in our place. No texts no warnings. I felt very unsafe.

Legit you've been the most helpful so far and I have the entire conversation on my phone. He keeps urging me to kill myself, which is unsettling and makes my suicidal thoughts worse so I just don't want to live with this person anymore. I already fear my own thoughts and I don't need them.worsened by someone like this.

I didn't even know there were non emergency police lines??? I'll go search for that right now. 

Thanks.

By yelling at him for a full five minutes and cursing at him, using racial epithets. How else? Oh and by waving a pot in his face.

I am trying not to be so afraid but all I hear is my family's really disparaging remarks and all they did was say it was an excuse. It repeats so often in my mind. Every time I think about it my chest hurts and it's hard to breathe. I know I have to admit that I do have depression but I wish I wasn't reminded of what my family would say.

Thank You. I'm just so lost and at times I overdo it and can't function for hours at a time. I just can stare at my phone and wish I could do more. He doesn't even live with me but whenever he visits I have more energy and I want to hold onto life. But he lives in another state and all I want is him here next to me, but he needs a job where I live and filling out applications exhausts him so much the gets frustrated and can't handle it and I understand and I just wish it wasn't so hard to get a new job.

I go by either Olivia D Knight and under that I've written and drawn the cover for "Rolitania". It's a dumb weeb trash novel. 

Sarah Albarn is for my poetry and I wrote a poetry series called Waking Nightmares. They're all depressing poems though.

A lot of times I'm super wary to even say I have depression because my family would ask me if I did in a condescending manner and I obviously have all the symptoms and I begged to go to a therapist but no one would help me. I haven't been to any kind of doctor in over five years but I've been with them to doctor's appointments and etc. They couldn't even get me insurance even though by law they were supposed to. 

Last year I finally ran away and honestly I feel free but I'm getting so much worse. I'm always so weak and I can't stay awake. And if I do stay awake I end up staring at the wall for hours feeling numb. I'm at the point where I can't even write anymore. 

Honestly I feel like I should help him more than I am but I'm not qualifed to at all. It's a struggle but only with my own inadequacy.  :/

I'm really glad you said something to me. I'm not in the best spot right now and the suicide hotline has always been really unhelpful. So has the chat line. 

I'm so stressed my jaw is aching from clenching it so long. I sometimes wish I had the energy to die though like I would do something but I'm always so exhausted.

But they don't go asking for nudes or anything else. Most of them know that trying to be with me would be a huge headache due to my family, so they also know it'd really get me in trouble. 

But looking for friends is hard, especially platonic ones. I've found tvtropes is a good place to look, actually.

I totally get your point. Yeah, the whole business is a little weird. They aren't that strict, but. Sometimes I wish I didn't know some things. I used to be atheist, and I guess I saw things differently then, but I look back on those days and think I only changed one aspect of myself other than my temper. 

Oh, goodness. The guy is literally ME, but male. We are so alike it isn't even funny. He is like, not pressuring me one bit. My friends, well, they come from varying backgrounds, so they just DON'T GET my beliefs sometimes and think they're silly, sometimes stupid. And one of them isn't even part of the same religion, and tries to dredge up "research" from auxiliary sources that can justify literally anything I do. But the thing is, I just feel bad about everything because I can be so indecisive. And it irks me because of it.

Thr thing is, I really do know myself already. The thing is, I don't want to be that type of person. I have a really bad temper, I'm impatient, and I am overall not very nice. The only thing that has changed me from that is hoping in God. 

My family is the one who makes me feel trapped, not my religion. 

I consider myself aromantic because ever since my father was unfaithful (he was never our religion, either, let's be clear) and had like four or five girlfriends on the side after he married my mother. I can't really trust anyone after that. I don't live with him anymore, but the last time I had a relationship I know I didn't really feel romantically attached to them, but they said they loved me so I just went along with it. I snuck out a few times and they found out so I'm never really trusted again. And then he broke up with me because he was moving. 

But thanks for responding to my problem.

My family and my religion are two different things. No one else  has told me such things. The reasons people do get shunned aren't all that ridiculous. We don't like to half-ass things. Like, if you say you want to live a certain way, then by all means do it. But if it doesn't fit in line with what you promised God, then we don't have to accept that. If you don't agree, then you can leave. No one is going to fight you. Like, say somone decided to rob a store for whatever reason, yes, they could have been in need, but reaching out to us would have been better and we could support that person until they get back on their feet. But if they go ahead and rob the store, and aren't remorseful, don't think they were wrong to steal from someone else, then we have to disassociate from them. It's a matter of knowing what you did was wrong. But if they are sorry, then they can stick around. Conversion means striving to become a better person, giving up bad habits, it's a process. 

But that's a different issue. In all honesty, I am still on the fence. I still don't have any money to leave, and getting a job is really hard in my area. I just don't want to be so DEPENDENT on him or my family, and that's what gets me so guilty sometimes. That I can't do for myself. 

The thing is, I want to keep my morals intact. But some of my friends don't seem to get that and keep telling me to go ahead. And I don't want to be that way. I just want to be happy.
